name: Romania

observations.reasoning: Sourced on 2026-07-27, transversal pass over the population indicator. Population on 1 January 2025: 19043151 inhabitants, recorded as 19.043 million. Eurostat dataset demo_pjan, Population on 1 January by age and sex, read through the dissemination API on 2026-07-27, dataset last updated 2026-07-09. Total population, both sexes, all ages, which is exactly what this indicator's denominator asks for. Read as one table covering every country in the record, so no value here is derived from a neighbour: each is that country's own row. The previous value was an opening estimate produced with no source and no research.

Web check of 2026-07-27, searched in the country's own language. One establishment retained: UNATC I.L. Caragiale, Bucharest. Criteria read at source: a bachelor's degree in Performing Arts (Puppets and Marionettes), four years, 240 ECTS, twelve places, paired with a master's in Animation Theatre; puppetry named in the award title; Romanian public national university. Counted by establishment: bachelor's and master's make one school. The previous value of 1.5 was not an observation but the midpoint of an estimated range; it is brought back to the established lower bound. Upper bound at 2: the arts university of Targu Mures was not checked in this pass. No source read claims exhaustiveness for Romania.

notes: Țăndărică, Bucharest. State puppet theatres in most county capitals.
to_check: Settle the denominator of the dates indicator before collecting anything.

venues and performances: NOT a settled negative, unlike Lithuania, Slovakia and Hungary. Romania's statistical office does publish the category — 'teatre de papusi si marionete' is one of its standard classes of performing institution, carrying a count of institutions, of spectacole and of spectatori. It could not be read on 2026-07-27: every route into insse.ro reset the connection at the transport layer, including the publication 'Reteaua si activitatea unitatilor cultural-artistice', the TEMPO interface and a regional office mirror. That is a failure of access from this machine, not an absence of data, and the difference matters — no value was recorded, and none should be inferred from the silence.

venues: the Ministry of Culture's Registrul Artelor Spectacolului was opened and read — 256 registered institutions with their city, county and founding public authority, which is exactly the right shape for this denominator. It carries no column for the kind of theatre, and Romanian puppet houses are mostly named for a character rather than for puppetry: Tandarica, Gulliver, Puck, Licurici, Colibri, Prichindel. Only one entry names itself, the Teatrul de Marionete Arad, founded by the Arad municipal council. Sorting the register by hand would mean deciding from memory which of 256 institutions are puppet theatres, which is not a reading. Cross it against the INS class instead, once insse.ro answers.
